$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: SplitButton
whenToUse: One main action with a few variations of it: “Deploy” / Deploy to staging / Deploy without cache.
The main action is what people want most of the time; the rest are occasional.

whenNotToUse.text: When none of the options is clearly the default
Destructive variants hidden in the menu

anatomy.description: `menuContent`: DropdownMenuItems — variants of the main action.

do.caption: The menu holds variants of the same action.
do.example:
<SplitButton
  size="md"
  menuLabel="More deploy options"
  menuContent={
    <>
      <DropdownMenuItem>Deploy to staging</DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuItem>Deploy without cache</DropdownMenuItem>
    </>
  }
>
  Deploy
</SplitButton>

dont.caption: Three buttons for one action crowd the bar; the rare variants belong in the menu.

a11y: Give the caret a specific `menuLabel` when there are several on a screen: “More send options”.
Two tab stops: the main action and the caret.

props.name: children
props.description: Label + icon(s) for the primary (left) action.

props.name: menuContent
props.description: Content rendered inside the DropdownMenu opened by the caret — typically DropdownMenuItem elements.

props.name: badge
props.description:
Count or status pinned to the top-right corner (a BadgeIndicator, sm,
circle). Pass a number/short text (`badge={5}`, `badge="9+"`), or an
object for a dot or another tone: `{ dot: true }`, `{ value: 3, tone: 'info' }`.
Default tone is danger. Not rendered with `asChild`.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description:
What the badge means, read after the button's name ("5 unread",
"new"). The badge itself is aria-hidden — without this, screen
reader users get no count at all. Dev warning when missing.

props.name: leftIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label (or the sole icon when iconOnly is set).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of leftIcon and disables the button. Not supported with asChild.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the caret that opens the menu. Default "More actions" — make it specific when several split buttons share a screen, e.g. "More send options".

props.name: onMainClick
props.description: Called when the primary action is clicked.

props.name: softDisabled
props.description:
Soft-disable: looks disabled and ignores clicks/Enter/Space, but stays
in the tab order and keeps receiving hover/focus (uses aria-disabled
instead of the native `disabled` attribute). Use it when the user needs
to find the button and learn WHY it's unavailable — wrap it in a
Tooltip with the reason. `disabled` stays the hard version (removed
from the tab order, no events at all).

props.name: success
props.description:
The action just succeeded: a tick draws itself in place of leftIcon (Kinetics'
Status Pill, MIT). Pair it with a label that says so ("Deployed") and, usually,
`tone="success"`; turn it off again after a moment. Not supported with asChild.
